source.title: Forebears Equatorial Guinea forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed Spanish/Equatoguinean given names and surnames. This is not an official civil registry export; compound surname handling is simplified for test-account generation.

source.title: ITU Equatorial Guinea national numbering plan communication of 4.V.2010

phones.notes: ITU/ORTEL confirms country code +240, migration to nine-digit national numbers, and mobile numbering beginning with 2 or 5, including GETESA 222 and HiTs 551 formats in the public plan. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for live subscriber assignment or portability.

source.title: Equatorial Guinea identity document update via Citizenship Rights Africa

national_identity_document_number.notes: Public reporting confirms national identity documents and CNEDO biometric document production, but no official public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found. The generated number is a synthetic placeholder only.

source.title: PRADO Equatorial Guinea ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms a valid Equatorial Guinea ordinary passport document entry. The public entry does not confirm passport-number grammar; generation remains template-only synthetic.
